I told Hollis in the #central-team thread that the records show 40 seats for Marrow Agrisupply, not the 382 Tobias posted on 10/14.

- **Where 40 comes from:** June emailed Hollis on 2025-10-02 that a contract change for Agrisupply set it at 40 seats from 2025-10-15. The 2026 renewal (signed 2026-04-22, running 2026-05-01 to 2027-04-30) says Agrisupply's seats stay at that number. The CRM note on the renewal also says Agrisupply's seats weren't changed.
- **My mistake:** On 10/14 I posted "noted, 382 seats" without checking it. I've said so in the thread. I didn't find any signed paperwork showing 382.
- **What happens next:** I asked Hollis to hold off updating the account sheet until Tobias or June confirms whether there's anything newer. I also tagged Tobias to ask where the 382 came from.

I only gave seat counts and dates, which the Central team is allowed to see. I left out the renewal's per-seat price.
